text:
jen (Support): Escalation from ACCT-4321 — customer reporting SSE streams that deliver an initial chunk then go silent for ~60s, client reconnects, then multiple auth checks/billing spikes. They see partial outputs (trailing commas) and reconnect loops. Attaching logs they shared.

alex (SRE): thanks, can you paste the exact client and headers? ALB/Cloudflare in front? sounds like idle timeout or buffering.

customer-jane: posting customer's repro: they use EventSource in browser (EventSource('/v1/stream', { withCredentials: true })). Headers: Cookie: session=abcd; Authorization header absent (browser using cookie). Flow: first data event arrives, then silence ~60s, then EventSource onerror triggers and it reconnects. They see 401 on reconnection then success on refresh token exchange.

mike (Edge Eng): hunch: two-layer problem: 1) proxy/LB idle timeout at ~60s (ALB default 60s) causing half-close; 2) Cloudflare/proxy buffering can suppress midstream bytes until buffers fill or connection closes; combined they yield silence then reconnect. When auth uses cookie, each reconnect triggers full auth path and billing.

jen (Support): customer's nginx config (they run private origin):
```
location /stream {
  proxy_pass http://upstream;
  proxy_http_version 1.1;
  proxy_set_header Connection "";
  proxy_buffering off;
  proxy_cache off;
}
```
They claim proxy_buffering off already but still see silence.

alex (SRE): can you paste upstream headers from our service? need to confirm Transfer-Encoding: chunked + content-type. If the server delays sending immediate chunked header or the first chunk is very small, some proxies will buffer. Also Cloudflare's HTTP/2 connection/windowing can cause pauses if no periodic flush.

customer-jane: curl reproduction they ran: 
```
$ curl -v -H "Cookie: session=abcd" https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream
> GET /v1/stream HTTP/1.1
< HTTP/1.1 200 OK
< content-type: text/event-stream; charset=utf-8
< transfer-encoding: chunked
< 
: ping
data: {"id":1,"text":"hello"}

# then nothing for 60s, then connection reset by peer
```

mike (Edge Eng): actionable checklist: 
- Ensure server sends an initial flush (small chunk) immediately after headers (e.g., colon heartbeat or tiny JSON) so proxies don't coalesce.
- Send heartbeat every 10-15s to keep TCP alive through ALB/Cloudflare. A single newline comment line is sufficient: `:\n`.
- For ALB: increase idle timeout > 60s (we recommend 350s for long-lived SSE).
- For NGINX: ensure `proxy_buffering off;` and `proxy_set_header Connection "keep-alive";` on upstream to avoid half-close behavior.
- For Cloudflare: set `Cache-Control: no-transform` and `Connection: keep-alive` and disable HTTP/2 prioritization if possible.

alex (SRE): note on auth/billing: cookie-based auth triggers our full token-exchange on each reconnect. Workaround: use Authorization: Bearer short-lived token in header for streaming clients; this avoids cookie session revalidation path.

jen (Support): customer tried rapid workaround: added client-side setInterval sending `fetch('/v1/keepalive')` to keep connection alive — reduces reconnects but not ideal.

mike (Edge Eng): we should add server-side mitigations: patch SSE handler to 
1) write immediate `:\n` after headers, flush
2) set `X-Accel-Buffering: no` for nginx compatible,
3) include `Connection: keep-alive`
I'll open PR for a small middleware that ensures periodic heartbeats and immediate flush.

alex (SRE): I'll open a support lane task to propose ALB idle timeout update for this customer and a canary to test 350s timeout. Also will ask infra to validate NLB/TG health check settings so they don't half-close streams.

jen (Support): customer asked if this is a bug in Redwood runtime. any logs from our side?

deploy-bot: patch/edge-sse-heartbeat v1.2.3 deployed to staging at 2026-03-11T03:22:10Z by mike.

alex (SRE): I pulled logs for that customer from our edge logs:
```
2026-03-10T12:03:15Z edge-out: stream open, client_id=acct-4321
2026-03-10T12:03:15Z edge-out: wrote initial chunk 48 bytes
2026-03-10T12:04:16Z edge-in: upstream connection reset by peer (code=ECONNRESET)
2026-03-10T12:04:16Z auth: 401 reauth attempt count=1
2026-03-10T12:04:16Z billing: reconnection churn detected, tokens_consumed=42
```

mike (Edge Eng): logs line up with ALB 60s default. Also we see the initial chunk was small; some proxies will consider it insufficient and coalesce until buffer thresholds or idle close. Heartbeat PR should mitigate.

jen (Support): customer agreed to test three things: (1) set ALB idle timeout to 350s (they can do); (2) apply our staging patch that sends heartbeats; (3) switch to header-based bearer token for streaming. They've scheduled a test window tomorrow. Will update after.

alex (SRE): long-term, we should document a recommended SSE origin config in KB: ALB idle timeout recommendation, nginx proxy settings, Cloudflare caveats, and auth guidance (prefer header tokens). I'll draft KB and link in the ticket.

mike (Edge Eng): created PR #452 to add heartbeat middleware + tests. assigned to @mike for review. :thumbsup:

jen (Support): assigning follow-ups: alex -> infra ticket to propose ALB change, mike -> PR and staging run, jen -> coordinate customer test. Closing internal escalation after test results.

customer-jane: thanks team — I'll post results after the test tomorrow.

jen (Support): thanks everyone.
